name: Lantern Rise
note: A hundred lanterns off the valley floor — the shot every photographer comes for.

name: The Bend at Dusk
note: Golden hour folds the river in half. Lan says the bend only holds the light for ninety seconds.

name: Night Heron
note: Still as a lantern post until it isn't. One frame, if you're lucky.

name: Valley Fog
note: The camp floats. Guests' lanterns hang in the white like embers that forgot to burn out.

name: Low Ember
note: The fire at coal-time — Lan taught the warden to meter for the coals, not the flames.

name: First Lantern
note: The valley's own ritual: someone always lights the first one early, alone.
